notes: V0.9.1 hotfix: fixes the v0.9.0 crash on open. Push.register() no longer runs automatically — it is gated behind a pushReady flag (default false) because the Capacitor PushNotifications plugin's register() calls FirebaseMessaging.getInstance(), which throws a native IllegalStateException that can crash the app when Firebase is not configured (no google-services.json yet). Registration only runs once Firebase is actually in the build. Also removes the createChannel() call. Everything else from v0.9.0 is kept (server /push-token, notifyNew exact-alarm/Doze fix, diagnostics).
